title: Samsung 512GB PRO Ultimate microSDXC Memory Card $150 + Delivery ($0 to Metro/ OnePass/ C&C/ in-Store) @ Officeworks
body:
Deal: Samsung 512GB PRO Ultimate microSDXC Memory Card $150 + Delivery ($0 to Metro/ OnePass/ C&C/ in-Store) @ Officeworks

[siruba] Decent deal for the Pro Ultimate.
FWIW, occasionally Amazon DE via AU would have some pretty good deals on storage, e.g. the Lexar "Play" 1TB for $200. Same with USB thumb drives. Believe not too long ago there was even a Sandisk Ultra 1TB for $136 (unclear how many were fulfilled).
So if you don't need a specific card model, just keep checking often.
[jc209964] Product name reminds me of Finish dishwashing tablets.
[seedosrun] "high endurance" type cards are generally recommended for dashcams, you don't need massive throughput for the dashcam, but you do need endurance for hundreds/thousands of write cycles.
[supersabroso] You roll the dice when you use them for dashcams because it voids the 10 year warranty. However, it's worked well for me as I've never had a Samsung microSD card fail on me in the last decade and I've put them into 6x dash cams. The bigger the card, the less likely it'll fail as you write less cycles.
[plmko] Same my 128gb EVO is now about 8 years old and still going in the Viofo.
IMO endurance cars are snake oil. Ratings don't replace periodic checks. It's false security for user.
[RBZ10] Lmfao pro ultimate?!? They forgot to put max on the end 😂
Dont really think its pro or ultimate with v30 speeds if was v60 or v90 yeah sure
[Phoebus] If your device supports UHS-II V60. Not many do. But if Samsung ever makes one of those it will be called Pro Ultimate Raptor Max Annihilator
[aligab] You need endurance for dashcam regardless of brand, lexar, samsung whichever.
This one is for photography and 4k but still limits cinematic but for everyday user its fine for pboto and drone etc
[sando] Don't buy this for a dashcam or anything that does constant writes. The product page explicitly says that the 10-year warranty does not apply when used in that way.
Limited 10-year warranty. * Warranty does not extend to dashcam, CCTV, surveillance camera and other write-intensive uses. * Warranty for SD adapter is limited to 1 year.
https://www.samsung.com/au/memory-storage/memory-card/memory…
[Remorhaz] Holy crap these have gone up in price - I paid $80 for this exact same card back in mid 2024
[JoeBogan] https://amzn.asia/d/0iZkew4j
This PNY one which is the same class is $130.99 , ships and sold from Amazon AU.
